title: Vulkan device lost after restoring minimized editor on Android
body:
### Tested versions

Godot 4.4 Stable With some bugs found that were not in the Godot 4.3 Stable version

### System information

Godot Engine v4.4.stable.official.4c311cbee - https://godotengine.org Vulkan 1.1.128 - Forward Mobile - Using Device #0: Qualcomm - Adreno (TM) 710

### Issue description

Godot Engine v4.4.stable.official.4c311cbee - https://godotengine.org
Vulkan 1.1.128 - Forward Mobile - Using Device #0: Qualcomm - Adreno (TM) 710

--- Debugging process stopped ---
Device: Edge 50 Fusion (Motorola)

The following error:
  ERROR: QueuePresentKHR failed with error: VK_ERROR_SURFACE_LOST_KHR

Happens when the engine is minimized

Not only that, but I also noticed that there is an error loading a certain resource, even though the project seems to work fine. In addition to the engine notifying that some resource has been modified on disk, even though I do not change the project files. 

This error appears when the engine is opened for the first time:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/61fa860d-4c1a-44b5-bafa-893e95681e9e)

### Steps to reproduce


Bug 01:   ERROR: QueuePresentKHR failed with error: VK_ERROR_SURFACE_LOST_KHR

•It happens when I minimize the engine on a mobile device.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Bug 02:   ERROR: scene/resources/resource_format_text.cpp:282 - Parse Error: Busy. [Resource file res://levels/0/level_0.tscn:110]
  ERROR: Failed loading resource: res://levels/0/level_0.tscn. Make sure resources have been imported by opening the project in the editor at least once.
  ERROR: scene/resources/resource_format_text.cpp:282 - Parse Error: Busy. [Resource file res://levels/0/level_0.tscn:110]
  ERROR: Failed loading resource: res://levels/0/level_0.tscn. Make sure resources have been imported by opening the project in the editor at least once.

•The bug happens every time I reopen Godot
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Bug 03:

•Notifications indicating changes to the disk when I haven't changed anything, could it be the engine that changed it?
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
